name: pdfcn
one_liner: Builds invoice and report PDFs from React components you paste in.

text.why: Generating a PDF from a web app means choosing a renderer and laying out the document from scratch. pdfcn copies PDF components and blocks into your project through the same registry format and CLI flow as shadcn/ui, rendering through either Takumi or Forme. The code lands inside your project, so changing it is yours to do. Published under MIT, with every component previewed on the docs site, where the install command also lives rather than in the README.
text.take: The shadcn model applied to PDFs: the components become your code, not a dependency.
build: Order confirmations and invoices generated inside the app
A monthly report that moves dashboard numbers into tables and charts
An internal document template set sharing one brand theme

who.situation: needs invoice and report PDFs in the app
wants PDFs handled in the same workflow

caveat: No install command in the README; see the docs site
Depends on the Takumi or Forme renderer

license.scope_text: Use, change and redistribute, commercially too. Keep the notice.
